text: Whereas Hilbert's continuity axiom quantifies over arbitrary sets of points (second-order), Tarski replaces it with a first-order ___ (one axiom per pair of formulas) that quantifies only over definable cuts.
explanation: Tarski's continuity is an axiom schema — like Separation in ZF or Induction in PA — with one instance per pair of first-order formulas, ranging only over definable Dedekind cuts. This surrenders Hilbert's categoricity but makes the theory a genuine first-order theory subject to completeness and decidability.
